1995 · Political leader · Assassination

Yitzhak Rabin

Rabin was implementing the Oslo peace process and negotiating territorial and security changes opposed by powerful political and religious factions. Rabin's death weakened the peace process and transformed Israeli politics.

1995 · Environmental activist · Execution

Ken Saro-Wiwa

Saro-Wiwa led nonviolent opposition to oil pollution and demanded political and economic rights for the Ogoni people. The executions triggered international sanctions and became a landmark in corporate human-rights accountability.
